requirements.statement: Information that an image or group of images gives by shape, size or position can also be obtained by another means.

citations.quote: pour chaque image ou ensemble d’images, l’information ne doit pas être donnée uniquement par la forme, taille ou position
Retrouver dans le document les informations d’une image données par la forme, la taille ou la position

routes.statement: For each piece of information given by shape, size or position, another means of obtaining that information exists.

citations.quote: Pour chaque information donnée par la forme, la taille ou la position, vérifier qu’il existe un autre moyen de récupérer cette information

rationale.text: The test asks whether information given by the shape, size or position of an image or group of images can also be obtained another way. Both halves are judgment. Which visual effect carries information is not fixed: the glossary gives three examples, a marker for the active page of a menu, a tab brought to the foreground, font sizes in a tag cloud, and then extends to any similar graphic effect. Whether another means gives the same information (a text, a heading, a state exposed to assistive technologies, a caption) needs the information to be understood first. So code can neither find the elements the test applies to nor decide the route for them, and no check is linked. No axe rule is tagged for this test. A purpose-built check was considered and rejected: even a case that looks mechanical, such as items of differing font sizes with no other cue, is a failure only if the sizes carry information, which is judgment. The candidate is none. Applicability is judgment: a page may hold images that give no information by shape, size or position, and telling them apart is judgment, so code cannot decide that the test does not apply. Needs is empty: images and their surroundings are examined on the page as loaded. Information shown only after an interaction is examined on a declared state.

citations.quote: vérifier qu’il existe un autre moyen de récupérer cette information
